house.description: Parental notification of adverse incidents required.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Education Policy

additions: within 24 hours of receiving the report of the incident
For purposes of this section, "prohibited conduct" has the meaning given in section 121A.031, subdivision 2.
A school district or charter school must notify the parent or guardian of a student within 24 hours of receiving a report that:
(1) the student was the target of violence, harassment, or prohibited conduct by another student or district or school employee or agent;
(2) the student engaged in violence, harassment, or prohibited conduct; or
(3) a teacher, principal, employee, bus driver, or other agent of the district or school has used reasonable force against the student under section 121A.582.
A notification under this section must be consistent with state and federal data practices law governing access to data, including section 13.02, subdivision 8 .
